summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend testing all passing. Backend: 24/24 pytest (all previous 22 kept green + new tests for /food/today macro totals and real Razorpay checkout). GET /api/subscription/me now returns rzp_configured=true; POST /api/subscription/checkout returns 200 with subscription_id=sub_..., key_id=rzp_test_..., amount_paise=3900; second call is idempotent (same subscription_id). Trial precedence verified: after checkout, sub still reports trial_active=true, paid_active=false, days_left>0 even though Razorpay entity status is 'created'. GET /api/food/today returns total_protein_g/total_fat_g/total_carbs_g and each item retains protein_g. Existing suites (auth, profile, food CRUD, paywall 402, webhook/callback HMAC 400) all green. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667): today-protein pill shows '35g' on Home under the calorie ring; food row shows 35g protein next to Chicken breast (log-protein-<id> visible); /subscribe renders price-card + payment-options block with 'UPI Autopay / Debit / Credit / Net Banking / Wallets' chips + sub-terms + sub-privacy + start-checkout-btn (no sub-error shown when tapped); /signup shows signup-legal; Profile shows link-terms and link-privacy which route to /terms and /privacy screens; both terms-close and privacy-close close buttons work; direct routes /terms and /privacy render fine. No console errors, no red screen.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py 586 lines — still under the 700 threshold but close; when adding webhook signature verification or dunning logic, split into routers/{auth,subscription,food}.py.
sub_public correctly computes trial_active from trial_ends_at and not paid_active, so the trial takes precedence over Razorpay's 'created' status right after checkout — verified.

/subscription/checkout is idempotent by checking existing.status in {authenticated, active, pending, created}; if Razorpay returns a status outside that set the code would create a duplicate sub. Consider using existence of razorpay_subscription_id as the sole gate (or extend the whitelist).
RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET still placeholder; webhook endpoint returns 400 for any signed event, which is fine until webhook is wired. Add a startup log or /health check to make this visible.
